description:
LOOK UP a DEX's official documentation: the raw excerpts closest to your words,
        with their source pages (APIs, SDK, accounts, orders, margin, funding, liquidations,
        fees, vaults). dex: decibel, hyperliquid, lighter or gmx (empty = the DEX your words
        name, else Decibel). A search, not an answer: instant, nothing is published, no model
        involved. For an explanation written by the DEX's expert use ask_expert. No
        registration needed.
name: dex_docs
